positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Back-end Software Engineer working on M365 Copilot. Previously worked on Fluid Framework, Intentional Platform & Programming, and Whiteboard App for web and desktop.

I also have experience leading the following:

1. Sprints & sprint boards for the entire broader team (100+). I managed and facilitated team-wide weekly syncs across all sub-teams for this broader team
2. Testing the limits of software on all devices. I organized, lead, mentored, and automated the process of testing both software & hardware. I have made the process simple for others to onboard due to the automation script I integrated & thorough documentation
3. Hackathon organization for the org-level for many large teams (2000+), including logistics, budget, and demo day (including all org-wide communications)
4. Early documentation set-up for the team, including code documentation, processes, logistics, hackathon management, and weekly sync notes for every meeting

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Software Engineering Intern who worked on the Whiteboard App for Windows.

positions.title: Lab Assistant & Academic Intern
positions.description: Assisted in instructing labs and office hours of students with and without prior programming experience for CS 61B (Data Structures under Josh Hug) and CS 61A (The Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs under John DeNero).

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Back-end software engineer responsible for the implementation of core channels such as Expedia and QuickBooks, bridging the connection of vacation rental properties across Orbirental and other essential channels via RESTful API integration. API integration was completed through Java's JAXB and JavaServer Pages.

projects.title: SQL Database Management System
projects.description:
• Implemented a persistent B+ Tree that enables the indexing of database tables by primary key,
improving key searches from linear to logarithmic time complexity.
• Optimized the cost of inner joins via the Sort-Merge Join algorithm.
• Reduced costs for queries via an optimizer that estimates the most cost-efficient query plans.

projects.title: Berkeley Maps
projects.description:
• Developed the back-end of a web mapping application for the city of Berkeley that displays Berkeley’s hotspots and the quickest routes between locations via the A* Search algorithm.
• Implemented map scrolling and zooming in & out via QuadTrees.
• Achieved greater functionality through a location search tool with auto-completion via Tries.
